categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Liance Electromechanical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent testing equipment for power systems, as well as providing power system testing and validation services. Its products and services cater to new energy vehicles, fuel vehicles, marine, and aerospace sectors, including testing of engines, powertrains, and related components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced modular design, customized manufacturing, and simulation technologies for hardware development. It has proprietary software platforms supporting test preparation, simulation, data analysis, and control, with features like high-speed data acquisition, cloud storage, and compatibility with industry standards (INCA, ASAM, ASAP3). Key technologies include high-dynamic response electric dynamometers, hydraulic dynamometers, quick-connect systems, and aerospace-grade high-speed hydraulic dynamometers, emphasizing precision, anti-cavitation, and real-time control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading automotive manufacturers and research institutes in new energy vehicles (e.g., SAIC, GAC, Huawei, NIO, BYD), fuel vehicles (e.g., Weichai, Geely, FAW, Dongfeng), marine engine manufacturers (e.g., Weichai Heavy Machinery, China Shipbuilding Group), and aerospace entities (e.g., China Aero Engine Corporation, AVIC). The company serves R&D, production, and aftermarket testing needs across these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with laboratory and service locations in Nantong, Shanghai, Ningbo, Hefei, Dongguan, and other cities. It has begun expanding into European markets through overseas investments and subsidiaries, including a wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary and investments in European companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Liance operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the power system testing supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of testing equipment and provision of testing services to OEMs and research institutions. It procures key components from upstream suppliers but does not engage in raw material extraction or final vehicle assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in power system testing technologies, with stable R&D investment (~7.4% of revenue). It focuses on developing high-dynamic response testing equipment, aerospace-grade hydraulic dynamometers, and integrated software platforms. Future R&D priorities include expanding aerospace testing capabilities, enhancing energy flow simulation for new energy vehicles, and advancing intelligent manufacturing and smart factory construction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized intelligent testing equipment and provision of testing and validation services. The company also earns from spare parts sales, maintenance services, and limited distribution channels. Sales are mainly conducted via direct contracts and bidding with major automotive and aerospace clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in power system testing equipment for new energy vehicles and fuel vehicles, with growing presence in marine and aerospace sectors. It competes with international established firms that have technological advantages, especially in aerospace testing. Jiangsu Liance is recognized for its indigenous innovation and import substitution capabilities, particularly in aerospace hydraulic dynamometers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 493 million, a slight decline of 0.42% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.5 million, down 8.99%. Total assets reached RMB 1.31 billion, with net assets of RMB 918.5 million. The company maintains steady R&D investment and has expanded its testing capacity by over 39% in test benches. Employee count grew by 12% to 511. The company pursues moderate growth with focus on market expansion and technology leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Liance offers highly customized, modular intelligent testing solutions with proprietary software platforms that provide comprehensive, integrated testing and data analysis capabilities. Its products feature high precision, real-time response, and advanced simulation technologies tailored for diverse power systems in new energy vehicles, fuel vehicles, marine, and aerospace applications. The company emphasizes import substitution, especially in aerospace testing equipment, and provides localized, cost-effective solutions with strong after-sales service and technical support.
